# Contributing to KeyTween

Thank you for trying KeyTween. Reports and ideas are welcome, in English or Korean.

## Reporting a problem or asking for a feature

Open an issue: <https://github.com/UnialGames/KeyTween/issues>. The forms ask for what is needed to look into it
(KeyTween and Unity versions, the steps). Check the
[FAQ and troubleshooting](https://unialgames.github.io/KeyTween/articles/en/troubleshooting.html) first for the common cases.

## Pull requests

This repository is the published package: each release is generated from a development repository (the package, these
documents, and the tests run there). A change merged here directly would be replaced by the next release.

- Open an issue first to agree on the change.
- A pull request is welcome as a concrete proposal. When it is accepted, the change is applied in the development
  repository with you credited, and it reaches this repository with the next release.
- Keep it small and say how you checked it (which Unity version, what you played).

## Documentation

The documents in `Docs~` and the READMEs are generated the same way. Mistakes and unclear passages are worth an issue too.
